title: Ramification invariants of pure extensions
summary: We study ramification invariants of finite separable extensions of valued fields that are pure on a primitive element. In the immediate unibranched case, we prove that the extended trace ideal is generated by minimal-polynomial derivatives of integral primitive elements and that the Dedekind different is its divisorial closure. For Galois extensions, we express this derivative ideal as a product of subgroup ramification ideals. These formulas extend prime-degree calculations to pure extensions of higher degree.
